reading.title: Outdoor documentation, trail hiking and night sky observations
reading.text: Nature photography uses telephoto lenses and manual exposure settings to capture wildlife behaviors and scenic mountain vistas. Rock climbing ascends stone, and biking rides trails. The hiker frames an eagle using their digital photography camera. To hike is to walk extended distances through natural landscapes, rugged forest trails, and mountainous paths for exercise and recreation. Fishing catches fish, and cooking prepares food. The family packs daypacks to hike to the scenic lookout. To star gaze is to observe constellations, passing satellites, and distant planets across clear, dark night skies away from city light pollution. Paddling moves boats, and cooking heats food. Campers lie back on sleeping pads to star gaze under the Milky Way.
